summary: Backend testing of new features (global T&C acceptance + admin insights endpoints + orders CSV custom range). Created /app/backend/tests/test_terms_and_insights.py with 17 new tests covering every acceptance criterion — all 17 PASS. Ran full regression: 69 pass, 1 legacy test fails as a legitimate side-effect of the new feature (test_features.py::TestEDO::test_edo_full_flow now needs the demo customer to POST /auth/accept-terms before signing E-DO). No backend bugs found — the new implementation matches the spec exactly.

minor.issue: Existing regression test fails with 400 'Please accept the T&C on the home screen first'. Root cause is intentional new behavior — the E-DO submit now enforces global T&C acceptance. Fix: add `requests.post(f'{API}/auth/accept-terms', headers=cust_headers)` before the E-DO submit call in this test.

action_items: Update /app/backend/tests/test_features.py::TestEDO::test_edo_full_flow to call POST /api/auth/accept-terms with the demo customer's token before submitting E-DO (legacy test needs update because of new global T&C requirement). No production code changes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1885 — sales-monthly aggregation matches on {'$gte': start} but uses no end bound; harmless (future orders shouldn't exist) but consider bounding to now for safety.
server.py:1918 — export_products_sold_csv calls products_sold(admin, from_, to_) directly. Works but bypasses FastAPI dependency injection; fine as a helper, just noting.

server.py:369 — _must_accept_terms compares tz-aware `accepted` datetime with `updated`. Both come from datetime.now(timezone.utc) and Mongo preserves tz on decode by default with motor — verified passing tests confirm no naive/aware mismatch.

success_rate.backend: 100% for new features (17/17). Overall regression: 69/70 (98.6%) — the 1 failure is a legacy test not adapted to the new global T&C requirement, not a product bug.

seed_data_creation: Test file creates fresh customers with unique emails `tnc_<suffix>_<uuid>@example.com`. All test writes are cleaned up in-flight (settings text and company_contact are restored to original in try/finally blocks). Uses UNIQUE new emails per acceptance-criteria guidance so tests are idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend features (global T&C + admin insights + orders CSV range) are fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_terms_and_insights.py (17 tests).
